definitions.gloss: alms round; begging for alms (by Buddhist monks)
definitions.explanation: The Buddhist practice in which monks go out with a bowl to receive food or money from lay people, who gain merit by giving.

examples.japanese: {托鉢|たくはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: To go out on an alms round.

examples.japanese: {僧|そう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{托鉢|たくはつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Monks walk through the town collecting alms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧、{托鉢|たくはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧{家々|いえいえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}っていた→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Early in the morning, monks on their alms round went from house to house in a line.

notes:
In Japan, monks in deep straw hats can be seen collecting alms at stations and street corners; in Thailand and Laos the morning alms round is a daily sight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {托鉢|たくはつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out on an alms round
- {托鉢僧|たくはつそう}: mendicant monk
- {托鉢|たくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to beg for alms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: religious training, of which the alms round is one part
- ⟦{布施|ふせ}→布施：24600_fuse⟧: an offering given to monks
